offers_products.reason: Produces lithium compounds, bromine specialties and catalysts, chemical products sold to battery, electronics and other manufacturers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from chemical product sales; any technical support is incidental to products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells lithium and specialty chemicals to industrial customers such as battery makers, refiners and electronics manufacturers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are battery and automotive supply chain companies, electronics makers, refiners and pharmaceutical manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Lithium, bromine and catalyst chemicals are repeatedly ordered by manufacturers, often under supply agreements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Lithium demand tied to EVs and electronics is volatile; industrial buyers can cut orders in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Bulk chemical shipments are repeat supply purchases, not large infrequent one-off buys.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from mined resources, chemical plants and manufactured materials, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large battery makers, automakers' suppliers, electronics, energy and pharma companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates lithium brine and hard-rock mines, conversion plants and bromine production facilities needing heavy capital investment.
